cases.expected: Message.getResolver() returns Optional.of(the same DummyResolver instance)
cases.description: Verify that calling setResolver with a valid Resolver stores the reference and that getResolver() returns an Optional containing that exact instance.
Confirm that passing null to setResolver clears the resolver field and that getResolver() reports an empty Optional.

cases.expected: Message.getResolver() returns Optional.of(the new DummyResolver instance) after a previous non‑null resolver was set
cases.description: First set a resolver (e.g., DummyResolver A) on a fresh Message, then call setResolver again with a different resolver (DummyResolver B). Verify that getResolver() now returns Optional containing B, confirming that the previous resolver is correctly overwritten.

cases.expected: Message.getResolver() returns Optional.of(resolverInstance) and the internal reference is unchanged after the second call
cases.description: Set the same Resolver instance on a Message twice. The second call should not create a new reference or alter state; getResolver() must still return the original instance wrapped in Optional.

cases.expected: Message.getResolver() returns Optional.empty() after a resolver had been previously set
cases.description: Assign a non‑null Resolver to the Message, then call setResolver(null). Verify that the resolver field is cleared and getResolver() yields an empty Optional.

group: setResolver does not affect other Message state

cases.expected: Message.getHeader() returns the original Header instance unchanged
cases.description: Create a Message, capture its Header (or set a custom Header), then call setResolver with a valid Resolver. Ensure that the Header object returned by getHeader() is identical to the one before the call, proving that setResolver only touches the resolver field.
